therapiesPage.howTitle: Four ways to use a therapy oil

diffuse.title: Diffuse
diffuse.text: 6–8 drops in a diffuser with water. Let it run for 30 minutes in a closed room.

inhale.title: Inhale
inhale.text: Two drops in your palms, rub, cup over your nose and take three slow breaths.

massage.title: Massage
massage.text: Mix 3–4 drops with a spoon of carrier oil and massage into shoulders, temples or feet.

bath.title: Bathe
bath.text: Stir 5 drops into a spoon of milk or carrier oil, then add to warm bathwater.

therapiesPage.safety: Always patch-test first and keep oils away from eyes and children. If you are pregnant, nursing or have a medical condition, speak to your doctor before use. Our therapies support everyday wellbeing — they are not a medical treatment.
therapiesPage.empty: New blends for this need are on their way.
